doc.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Closing remarks
summary: Thanks and goodbyes, with Corea saying he enjoys history as long as it isn't taken as rules.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Thank you. It was an honor to spend two hours with you. You’re so concise.
Great pleasure, man, on my part. Thanks for your interest. It was fun talking about the days.
I know you don’t care to dwell on history.
It’s fun. I enjoy it, just so long as none of it is taken as any kind of rules or anything.
